author: 5kO0
content:
Implemented (this session). Added the wild_corpus_compiles test in proto-blue-codegen/src/main.rs that:

1. Skips silently when lexicons.wild/ is absent
2. Marked #[ignore] (slow); explicit invocation: cargo test -p proto-blue-codegen wild_corpus_compiles -- --ignored --nocapture
3. Synthesises a self-contained side-workspace crate at <workspace>/target/wild-corpus-compile/ with:
   - Cargo.toml mirroring proto-blue-api's dependency shape (path deps to workspace crates, plus thiserror/serde/chrono)
   - lib.rs with pub mod generated; + auto-detected pub use generated::<segment>; for each top-level NSID-segment found
   - All generated files written to src/generated/
4. Runs cargo build, panics with stderr if rustc emits any diagnostic

Updated Cargo.toml synth: includes thiserror (initially missing — caused 150 cascading errors before being added).

Verification:
  Bundled 322-doc corpus (symlink lexicons → lexicons.wild): PASSED in 11.5s (368 generated files, all compile clean)
  420-doc wild slice (app+chat+com+tools scraped 2026-05-08): FAILED with 8 errors in 9.3s, surfacing 2 distinct codegen bugs:
    - 3× E0761 leaf-and-parent collision  → filed as sub-issue #23
    - 1× E0583 dash-segment path/ident mismatch → filed as sub-issue #24
    - 4× E0433 cross-TLD refs to community.* (partial-corpus artifact, NOT a codegen bug)

Categorisation per rust-fix-discipline:
  - #22 deliverable: Category A — added the missing rustc-compile validation pathway end-to-end. Test mechanics confirmed working against known-good bundled corpus.
  - The codegen bugs the test surfaced (#23, #24): NOT in scope for #22; filed separately so they have their own fix conversations.

Behavioural change: the test is opt-in (skipped on absent corpus, also #[ignore]-gated). Per-PR CI is unchanged. Adds a deferred-but-discoverable second-order check that anyone running the wild-corpus path can trigger explicitly.

Files changed:
  proto-blue/crates/proto-blue-codegen/src/main.rs   — added wild_corpus_compiles test (+~110 LOC)

Verification (rust-quality §honest reporting):
  cargo build -p proto-blue-codegen --tests   PASS
  cargo test -p proto-blue-codegen            PASS (17 passed; wild_corpus_compiles correctly ignored)
  cargo test -p proto-blue-codegen wild_corpus_compiles -- --ignored (against bundled symlink): PASS in 11.5s
  cargo test -p proto-blue-codegen wild_corpus_compiles -- --ignored (against 420-doc wild slice): FAIL surfacing #23 + #24 (the test working as designed)
  cargo clippy -p proto-blue-codegen --all-targets -- -D warnings   PASS
  cargo fmt --all --check                                            PASS

The test is designed to fail loudly when codegen has bugs; that's its job. With #23 and #24 fixed, it should pass against any complete wild corpus.
